_note: D19 (2026-11-24). Default during the run: households that enter default after the start, as a share of all households (fractions; x100 for points), so the two groups sum to all. Redrawn population: seeds 110,000-110,099, one population draw per replicate shared by its BNPL-off and BNPL-on runs, paired by draw. se: paired standard error; sd: SD of the per-seed (per-draw) differences. w5_hhwage._note: w5_hhwage (hhderived) against the sum over household members of eight indderived monthly components: fwag (primary and secondary jobs), cwag (casual work), swag (self-employment), prof (profit share), extr (piece-rate), bonu (bonuses), cheq (13th cheque) and help (helping friends).
